resources.string: We’re a group of IT students from Cebu Institute of Technology University, working on building apps that offer something a little different. Zodiac Hue is one of our projects, where we share daily quotes and lucky colors based on your zodiac sign.\n

Coding is something we spend a lot of time on, whether it\'s for class or personal projects. We\'re always testing, debugging, and trying to make sure everything works smoothly. We want Zodiac Hue to be easy to use and enjoyable for everyone.\n

Each project we take on helps us learn more, whether it\'s how to structure an app better, or how to connect with users in a more meaningful way. We\'re not experts, but we keep improving, picking up new skills as we go along.\n

We\'re focused on making Zodiac Hue a fun and simple tool to brighten your day. With daily updates based on your zodiac sign, we aim to bring a little positivity and fun to your routine. We\'re excited to keep improving it and adding new features.
